issues.issue: Whether the respondent re-availed herself of China's protection by obtaining passports and making trips
issues.applicant_position: Minister: two Chinese passports and 12 trips to China show she re-availed herself of China's protection.
issues.respondent_position: Trips were for family reasons; re-availment needs intent to permanently reside, citing Kaissi.
issues.result_quote: I find that the Minister has established that the respondent has re-availed herself of the protection of her country of nationality.

issues.issue: Whether re-availment requires an intention to permanently reside in the country of nationality
issues.applicant_position: Intent to re-avail is enough; the permanent-residence test concerns re-establishment, not re-availment.
issues.respondent_position: Re-availment requires intent to permanently reside in China, per Kaissi and Camargo.
issues.result_quote: There is no requirement for the respondent to have the intention to permanently reside in China

issues.issue: Whether the reasons for the claim have ceased to exist (s. 108(1)(e), Falun Gong)
issues.applicant_position: Respondent no longer practises Falun Gong, so the reasons for her original claim have ceased.
issues.respondent_position: Fears a record of her Falun Gong affiliation with Chinese authorities.
issues.result_quote: The panel finds that the reasons for which she sought refugee protection have ceased to exist as she is no longer a Falun Gong practitioner.

issues.issue: Whether compelling reasons under s. 108(4) except her from cessation
issues.result_quote: The compelling reasons exception does not apply in this application.

issues.issue: Whether the cessation clauses must be applied in time order (change before re-availment)
issues.applicant_position: Minister: the change in circumstances may have come before re-availment, so the clauses should be applied in order.
issues.result_quote: Without knowing whether this occurred before or after her application for a Chinese passport and return to China in 2004, the Minister cannot establish
